_comment: San: 人生模拟器 - 完整成就配置
_total: 20个成就，分为4个阶层线 + 4个通用成就
_iconStyle: 统一像素艺术风格，32x32或64x64，深色背景+霓虹高亮

achievements._progression: 新手教程 → 生存考验 → 阶层突破 → 特殊事件

description.english: Experience your first death on the streets
description.schinese: 在街头经历第一次死亡

iconPrompt.style: Pixel art icon, 64x64, dark cyberpunk aesthetic
iconPrompt.elements: A cracked tombstone with pixelated angel wings, neon red 'GAME OVER' text glowing, dark blue background with rain effect
iconPrompt.color: Dark navy (#0a1628) background, neon red (#ff0040) highlights, gray stone texture
iconPrompt.mood: Somber but stylized, retro gaming death screen
iconPrompt.reference: Hotline Miami death screen meets Undertale pixel art

description.english: Survive 7 days without dying
description.schinese: 连续生存7天

iconPrompt.style: Pixel art icon, 64x64, gritty urban survival
iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated calendar with 7 days marked in red, torn and weathered, held by a skeletal hand, backdrop of city skyline silhouette
iconPrompt.color: Sepia and rust tones (#8B4513), blood red marks (#DC143C), dark gray background
iconPrompt.mood: Gritty determination, barely making it
iconPrompt.reference: Darkest Dungeon campfire icon style

description.english: Escape the homeless class and find stable work
description.schinese: 脱离 homeless 阶层，找到稳定工作

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated moth emerging from a broken cocoon made of cardboard and trash, one wing damaged but spread, ascending
iconPrompt.color: Dirty brown cocoon (#654321), iridescent teal wings (#00CED1), golden light rays
iconPrompt.mood: Hope amid decay, fragile transformation
iconPrompt.reference: Hollow Knight transformation aesthetic

description.english: Sleep on a park bench for 3 consecutive nights (Event: EVT_H01_BENCH)
description.schinese: 连续3晚在公园长椅过夜（触发事件：长椅禁令）

iconPrompt.style: Pixel art icon, 64x64, lonely urban night
iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated park bench under a flickering street lamp, snow or rain falling, empty coffee cup on ground, 'NO SLEEPING' sign crossed out
iconPrompt.color: Cold blue night (#1a237e), warm orange lamp (#ff6f00), white snow accents
iconPrompt.mood: Desolate but defiant, finding warmth in cold
iconPrompt.reference: Kentucky Route Zero minimalism

achievements._progression: 被剥削 → 觉醒 → 反抗 → 晋升

description.english: Trigger a union event as a worker
description.schinese: 作为 worker 触发工会事件

iconPrompt.style: Pixel art icon, 64x64, revolutionary propaganda poster style
iconPrompt.elements: Raised pixelated fist holding a wrench, breaking chains, industrial factory background with smokestacks, workers silhouettes
iconPrompt.color: Soviet red (#CC0000), industrial steel gray (#4a5568), golden dawn light
iconPrompt.mood: Revolutionary, empowering, dangerous hope
iconPrompt.reference: Soviet constructivist poster meets Papers Please

description.english: Work 7 consecutive days without rest
description.schinese: 连续工作7天没有休息

iconPrompt.elements: An exhausted pixelated worker at conveyor belt, clock showing 9-9-6, coffee cups piled up, eyes with dark circles glowing red
iconPrompt.color: Fluorescent office white (#f5f5f5), bloodshot red (#ff0000), coffee brown
iconPrompt.mood: Exhaustion, grinding, dark humor
iconPrompt.reference: The Office meets Cyberpunk corporate aesthetic

description.english: Report a黑心 factory's illegal practices (Event: EVT_WORKER_18_WHISTLEBLOWER)
description.schinese: 举报黑心工厂的违法行为（触发事件：吹哨人）

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated whistle with sound waves, secret documents flying, shadowy figure in background, 'TOP SECRET' stamp
iconPrompt.color: Noir black and white, spotlight yellow (#ffd700), redacted red
iconPrompt.mood: Dangerous truth, isolation, moral weight
iconPrompt.reference: Metal Gear Solid codec style meets All The President's Men

description.english: Escape the working class through promotion or education
description.schinese: 通过晋升或教育脱离工人阶层

iconPrompt.style: Pixel art icon, 64x64, corporate ladder symbolism
iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated diploma/degree floating above a ladder, breaking through glass ceiling with cracks, suit and tie below
iconPrompt.color: Parchment beige (#f5deb3), navy suit (#000080), shattered glass cyan
iconPrompt.mood: Ambiguous success, new chains, fragile ascent
iconPrompt.reference: Bioshock utopia/dystopia duality

achievements._progression: 背上房贷 →  HOA困境 → 中年危机 → 阶层跃迁

description.english: Take on a 30-year mortgage
description.schinese: 背负 30 年房贷

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated suburban house with golden handcuffs as door handles, '30 YEARS' sign, perfect lawn with dark shadows underneath
iconPrompt.color: Suburban beige (#d2b48c), prison gold (#ffd700), dark shadow purple
iconPrompt.mood: Gilded cage, suburban anxiety, beautiful prison
iconPrompt.reference: American Beauty meets Edward Hopper

description.english: Get fined by HOA for lawn violations (Event: EVT_MIDDLE_01_HOA_LAWN)
description.schinese: 因草坪违规被HOA罚款（触发事件：HOA草坪法）

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated ruler measuring grass height, magnifying glass over a single yellow leaf, 'VIOLATION' ticket, nosy neighbor peeking over fence
iconPrompt.color: HOA beige (#c2b280), warning yellow (#ffcc00), nosy pink (#ffb6c1)
iconPrompt.mood: Petty tyranny, surveillance comedy, suburban dread
iconPrompt.reference: The Truman Show meets Stepford Wives

description.english: Trigger a midlife crisis event (buy sports car or have an affair)
description.schinese: 触发中年危机事件（购买跑车或出轨）

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated red sports car with a question mark tailpipe, balding head with comb-over, wedding ring in rearview mirror, open road leading to cliff
iconPrompt.color: Crisis red (#dc143c), midlife gray (#808080), temptation gold
iconPrompt.mood: Desperate grasp at youth, pathetic grandeur
iconPrompt.reference: Fear and Loathing meets American Beauty

description.english: Escape the middle class and become a capitalist
description.schinese: 脱离中产阶层，成为资本家

iconPrompt.style: Pixel art icon, 64x64, class betrayal symbolism
iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated figure in suit climbing over a wall made of suburban houses, dropping mortgage papers, reaching for golden skyscraper above
iconPrompt.color: Middle class blue (#4682b4), capitalist gold (#ffd700), treason purple
iconPrompt.mood: Ambitious ascent, leaving behind, moral cost
iconPrompt.reference: The Great Gatsby green light meets Wolf of Wall Street

achievements._progression: 第一桶金 → 垄断 → 道德底线 → 终极剥削

description.english: Accumulate assets exceeding 1 million
description.schinese: 累计资产突破 100 万

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated money bag with '$1M' in blood red, gold coins spilling out with skulls on them, stock chart going up in background
iconPrompt.color: Blood money crimson (#8b0000), gold (#ffd700), corruption black
iconPrompt.mood: Wealth built on bones, capitalist excess, sinister success
iconPrompt.reference: Monopoly man meets Dark Souls soul counter

description.english: Achieve monopoly in any market sector (Event: EVT_CAPITALIST_03_TOO_BIG_TO_FAIL)
description.schinese: 在任意市场领域达成垄断（触发事件：大到不能倒）

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated board game monopoly piece (top hat) crushing small houses and shops, government building in pocket, 'BAILOUT' check
iconPrompt.color: Monopoly green (#00ff00), government gray, crushed red (#ff0000)
iconPrompt.mood: Corporate dominance, systemic corruption, untouchable
iconPrompt.reference: Mr. Robot E-Corp meets actual Monopoly board

description.english: Hide assets in offshore accounts (Event: EVT_CAPITALIST_07_OFFSHORE_HAVEN)
description.schinese: 在离岸账户隐藏资产（触发事件：离岸避税天堂）

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated palm tree on a tropical island made of documents, money flowing into a black hole, 'PRIVATE' stamp, IRS agent drowning in water
iconPrompt.color: Tax haven teal (#008080), money green, black hole black
iconPrompt.mood: Guilt-free greed, paradise built on exploitation
iconPrompt.reference: The Panama Papers meets The Beach

description.english: Get a heart transplant from a poor donor (Event: EVT_CAPITALIST_42_BLOOD_BOY)
description.schinese: 接受来自贫困捐赠者的心脏移植（触发事件：血童）

iconPrompt.style: Pixel art icon, 64x64, body horror capitalism
iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated golden heart in a glass case, poor figure lying down connected by tubes, 'PREMIUM UPGRADE' label, life support machine with dollar signs
iconPrompt.color: Medical white, class gold (#ffd700), exploitation red (#8b0000)
iconPrompt.mood: Literal body exploitation, wealth extension, moral bankruptcy
iconPrompt.reference: Repo Man meets Get Out, Cronenberg body horror

achievements._theme: 超越单个阶层的终极挑战

description.english: Experience all four social classes in one playthrough
description.schinese: 在单局游戏中体验所有四个社会阶层

iconPrompt.elements: Four pixelated figures in vertical stack connected by arrows: homeless (cardboard), worker (helmet), middle (suit), capitalist (top hat), circular cycle arrows
iconPrompt.color: Homeless brown, worker blue, middle gray, capitalist gold, rainbow gradient background
iconPrompt.mood: Full spectrum of experience, systemic understanding
iconPrompt.reference: The Great Chain of Being meets modern class analysis

description.english: Experience 50 unique random events
description.schinese: 体验 50 个独特的随机事件

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated book with '50/100' progress bar, event icons floating around (bench, bill, hospital, jail), System Gaze eye watching
iconPrompt.color: Book leather brown (#8b4513), event icons multicolor, Gaze purple (#9400d3)
iconPrompt.mood: Compulsive documentation, voyeurism of misery, completionism
iconPrompt.reference: Binding of Isaac item collection meets Wikipedia

description.english: Trigger any ironic ending (die from success, or win by failing)
description.schinese: 触发任意讽刺性结局（成功致死，或失败获胜）

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated theater mask (comedy and tragedy merged), capitalist at top of ladder falling, homeless at bottom catching his wallet, System Gaze laughing
iconPrompt.color: Theatrical gold (#ffd700), irony cyan (#00ffff), dark comedy purple
iconPrompt.mood: Dark humor, cosmic irony, system mockery
iconPrompt.reference: Black Mirror meets Waiting for Godot

description.english: Survive 365 days (1 year) in a single playthrough
description.schinese: 单局游戏存活 365 天（1年）

iconPrompt.elements: A pixelated hourglass with '365' in sand, seasons changing around it (spring flowers → summer sun → autumn leaves → winter snow), skeletal figure still standing
iconPrompt.color: Time gold (#ffd700), seasonal colors cycle, endurance silver
iconPrompt.mood: Endurance against time, survival as victory, temporal resilience
iconPrompt.reference: Dark Souls 'You Died' screen inverted, The Persistence of Memory
